objections.quote: So what will I get for them?

coaching_tip: When a customer questions the old-gold test, retest it in front of her and explain separately how purity and the melting deduction are each worked out, then offer to price the 31 g necklace on its own so the sale doesn't hinge on the exchange.
flags: purity dispute at 00:54 is about the test result on the customer's old gold; treated as old_gold_exchange_rate, not purity_trust
outcome walked_out: clip ends at 01:34 after old gold returned; no next step stated and no explicit statement about the necklace

customer.intent_evidence: 00:08 asked for necklaces between twenty and thirty-five grams; 00:24 brought old gold to exchange

key_moments.what: showed two necklaces within the asked 20-35 g range
quoted 86% purity plus a 2% deduction on old gold
answered the double-loss concern with 'That's our policy'
asked for her old gold back and refused the exchange

missed_opportunities.what: no retest of the old gold offered in front of the customer
no clear explanation of why purity and melting deduction are separate
no offer to price the 31 g necklace without exchange, and no number taken
